statements.quote: The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.
statements.notes: Says AI infrastructure investment will raise total operating costs; no amount or AI share given. 'Operating costs' may include depreciation and cost of revenue, not only R&D, infrastructure, or headcount opex. The sentence also covers non-AI items (cloud, devices).

statements.quote: We expect capital expenditures to increase in coming years to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure.
statements.notes: Names AI infrastructure as one driver of total capex growth alongside cloud. 'In coming years' names no specific fiscal year.
